paper_title: Experimental Search for Hidden Photon CDM in the eV mass range with a Dish Antenna
notes: First dish-antenna search for hidden photon CDM (Suzuki et al. 2015, arXiv:1504.00118). Paper quotes chi < ~6e-12 (95% CL) at m_gamma' = 3.1 +/- 1.2 eV, i.e. sensitive mass range ~1.9-4.3 eV set by PMT wavelength response (300-650 nm). Central value taken directly from text; endpoint values extrapolated using the chi ~ sqrt(m) scaling of eq. (1.1), so edge points are approximate (actual curve also depends on wavelength-dependent quantum efficiency and mirror reflectance shown in Fig. 5). Assumes DM entirely composed of hidden photons with rho_CDM = 0.3 GeV/cm^3. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.7, 3))
